column1: # TITLE: Expression data from CHRNA5 knockdown A549 lung cancer cells compared with control

# SUMMARY: Nicotine and nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (nAChRs) are considred to be involved in the progression of lung carcinomas. α5-nAChR is believed to be associated with lung cancer risk and onset
column2: however its function and physiologic roles is far from clear. We use microarry to detail the global programme of gene expression underlying knockdown CHRNA5
column4: in human lung cancer A549 cells compared with control.
